reviews.text: Very attentive. Friendly and welcoming service.

I'm so happy since Animalia was recommended to me. M. Jose is super attentive and professional; you can tell she loves her job. Every time I go, she gives me the confidence I need with my 12-year-old pit bull. Golfo doesn't come in very happy, haha, but when M. Jose gives him his treats, he leaves much happier. 🤣

An excellent veterinary clinic. María José herself is incredibly knowledgeable; she listens attentively and, based on the patient's history, pinpoints the problem. She's excellent, friendly, and approachable, and I've never had a problem where she didn't diagnose correctly or explain what she was going to do for my dog. I'm truly delighted with her. If you're looking for a good veterinarian, she's the one. I'm moving from Valencia, but María José will definitely remain my vet.

For the past few months, I've been taking my dog ​​Roma to this veterinary clinic, and I couldn't be happier or more grateful for the care they provide. Whenever I call or write to them because of a problem, they respond and make sure everything gets better. I have absolutely nothing bad to say about them. Their treatment is exceptional every time we go, and you can really see the love they have for the animals. I 100% recommend this veterinary clinic!

Today, with tears in my eyes, I want to thank M’ José for the love, professionalism, and sensitivity with which she cared for Lula until the very end.

Thank you for always looking after her until the very end and for helping us say goodbye to her with love.

Thank you also, Aurora, for your respect for Lula and your empathy towards us.

A few weeks ago, we took our senior cat to the emergency vet because he was having severe respiratory distress.
They attended to him almost immediately, and upon seeing his condition, they referred us to a center with more resources, also notifying them in advance to try to expedite the process.
Unfortunately, his condition worsened, and we ultimately had to put him to sleep. Even so, we remember with great gratitude the care he received, the speed with which they acted, and the empathy they showed during such a difficult time for us.

I've been taking Perla to this clinic for a while now, and I couldn't be more grateful. They've always treated both her and me with so much love, empathy, and patience. You can really tell when someone is passionate about animals and wants to help, because every time I've had an emergency or needed advice, they've been there without ever complaining.
Besides being professional, they're incredibly kind, something that's hard to find these days. And honestly, I also really appreciate that they're affordable and transparent, because they help you with the animal's well-being in mind, not just trying to make money. Perla goes there happy, and I have peace of mind knowing she's in good hands. I would recommend this clinic a thousand times over.

A completely trustworthy center with excellent professionals and, above all, wonderful people. Their extensive knowledge and passion for animals are evident. My daughter Adri loves going there, and I have peace of mind knowing she's in good hands. They are completely honest and transparent in their work.

I've spent almost my entire life at this clinic (and now my children do too). I've taken all my four-legged companions here, from my first dog as a child (Toy) to my current ones (Marshall, Harrison, and Emma), plus all those who are no longer with us. They've always helped, supported, comforted, and advised me through every joy and every difficult decision. They've healed, pampered, and cared for each and every one of them, and they continue to do so. I couldn't be more grateful. Thank you for everything that's happened and for everything that's yet to come.
Thank you so much, Rosa!
Thank you so much, Deborah! ♡

Both María José and Aurora treat Lúa with so much love, and over the years they've provided us with incredibly professional medical care! Thank you both so much. After six years with them, our family has grown ❤️
María José and Aurora are lovely, I always take my dogs here and both the service and professionalism are top-notch.
María José is an incredible professional. She's caring and friendly. You can tell she loves her job. An excellent veterinarian. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much for your review, Maria Trinidad!

I’m very satisfied with the service at this veterinary clinic. Both the doctor and the administrator were extremely polite, friendly, and highly professional. It was especially important for me that they spoke English, which made communication easy and comfortable.

All routine matters, such as vaccinations, were handled very quickly and efficiently. At the same time, the issues my cat had were carefully examined, all necessary tests were prescribed, and the treatment was thorough. Afterward, there were no complications at all.

Overall, I had a very positive experience and can confidently recommend this clinic.

Gracias  😻
If I could give a thousand stars, I would! Excellent Veterinarian!!!! María José, the best in the world!!!!

Since 1992, I've trusted this clinic to care for my pets' health. I can't say enough good things about their excellent service and professionalism. I couldn't trust anyone else as much as I trust them, especially Mjose. They're excellent in every way. Thank you.

We went with my 16-year-old dog, who was in a lot of pain and hadn't slept for a day. From the very first moment, the care was incredibly compassionate, both via WhatsApp and in person. They immediately made room in their schedule to see her.

They not only cared for my dog ​​with immense love and professionalism, but they also comforted me and kept me company as I was feeling sad and desperate.

Exceptional, compassionate, and professional care. I especially want to thank the veterinarian, María José, for her kindness and sensitivity.
Thank you so much for your feedback!

It's been about five years since I entrusted my dog ​​Mou's health to this team, and I couldn't be more grateful to have found them. They're not just veterinarians: they're people with enormous hearts, capable of conveying calm in difficult times and joy in good ones.

From day one, they treated us with a humanity and warmth that you don't find everywhere. You can tell they love their work and that every animal that walks through the door truly matters. With them, you don't feel like you're in a doctor's office: you feel like you're leaving your life companion in the hands of someone who cares for him with love and respect.

The value for money is unbeatable, but what's truly priceless is the peace of mind they give me every time Mou needs something. That's why, since I found them, I haven't gone to any other vet; I only stop going when they're closed because, naturally, it's not an emergency. But whenever I can, I wait until they open, because I know no one will take better care of him than they do.

Thank you for every gesture, every explanation, every visit, and every little detail. Thank you for being part of Mou's well-being and for always making us feel understood and supported. I wish more professionals were like this: humane, approachable, and extraordinary.
I've had my dogs here for 20 years and they've always been wonderful. Thank you, M. José, for your service and for everything, always.
I've been taking my cats there for 20 years, and the service and treatment are excellent. The animals are treated with great care, and the prices are very affordable. I give them an 11 out of 10.
Thank you so much for your stars, Fernando Gabriel!
Excellent service, very kind and caring towards my Lola, I recommend them 100%.
María José is a good and very kind veterinarian. The price is affordable. I'm very happy with how she treats my cat and because she tells me she's beautiful.

We want to express our gratitude for the personal and professional treatment we received from both María José, the veterinarian, and the staff. We are delighted.
Their dedication and love for animals is evident. Thank you very much.

I want to publicly thank María José for her great humanity and professionalism.

In our circumstances, her actions were outstanding.
Margarita (haschy dog)
Thank you so much

They've always treated us very well, both our dogs and us. María José is very approachable and kind. It's also clear they're not motivated by financial gain, as they've always been understanding and focused on what's best for the animals. Our dogs' problems have always been much easier to manage with her. A very good clinic overall.
Mari Jose is an extraordinary veterinarian, very kind and professional. The price is very reasonable too. It's a clinic where you can tell they love their work.
Thank you so much for your review!
Thank you so much, Mari!
Hi Dani! Could you tell us what you weren't happy with so we can improve? We couldn't find any pets registered under your name in our system. Best regards
The best vet, 25 years taking care of my pets, and saving two of my dogs...not mercenary at all, affordable and a wonderful person, ♥️
First consultation and we're happy. Thank you.
I've taken my two dogs and my cats there for years and they've always treated us wonderfully, both Maria José and Pepe. I recommend it 100%.

Thank you so much Maria Jose for everything, especially for your humanity. You often did it for Terry so he wouldn't suffer. I am very grateful. In the end, he passed away, but your treatment of him was exceptional.
Thank you so much Maria José, for making such an emotional moment as the loss of Toby more bearable for me.

Highly recommended. The treatment of both pets and owners is exceptional.

After 11 years of taking my furry friends there, I can only express my gratitude for the wonderful care they received. They were always efficient with any problem that might arise. Noa and Yure were always delighted to visit Maria Jose.
If I ever have another pet, I won't hesitate for a second to entrust them to you. Thank you for everything and for your professionalism.
I've been taking my dogs to them for years and I trust them completely. They're friendly and not at all money-grubbing. I highly recommend them.
